purpose.zh: 练肚子，手脚动的时候腰不离地
purpose.en: Builds your abs so your lower back stays down while your arms and legs move.

text.zh: 腰贴住地，一只手和另一边的腿慢慢伸远
text.en: Lower back down, slowly reach one arm and the other leg long

text.zh: 仰躺，两手指向天花板，胯和膝盖都弯成直角。
text.en: Lie on your back, arms to the ceiling, hips and knees bent at right angles.

text.zh: 慢慢收回来，再换另一组手脚。
text.en: Bring them back slowly, then switch to the other arm and leg.

text.zh: 左手右腿一次、右手左腿一次，合起来记 1 下。
text.en: Left arm with right leg, then right arm with left leg, makes one.

commonErrors.en: Lower back arching as you reach out.

cautions.en: If your lower back starts to arch, don't reach as far.

cautions.zh: 胯前面不舒服就腿放高点
cautions.en: If the front of your hip feels off, keep your leg higher.
